# The UI smoke set: about five minutes, run before every push.
#
# With the tests a change touches, this is the local half of the rule in
# CONTRIBUTING.md ("Before pushing"). It is not a substitute for the suite: CI
# runs every class on every code change, and the whole suite on both phones is
# for a build about to go to App Review.
#
#   tools/ui-tests.sh smoke
#
# One quick class per part of the game a change most often breaks, so a smoke
# failure says where to look. About five minutes on CI's runner, from the
# medians of six runs in October 2026; usually less on a desk.
#
# class                       what it covers
TitleScreenAppears            the title on a fresh install and on a new day, and Play to the board
HowToPlayOnce                 How to play on the first Play only
RackShape                     today's rack, in two rows of four
FirstFindShove                typing a word, and the first find leaving the list in place
MeterTopRung                  the meter at the top rung and at a full basket
DefinitionReveal              a found word's definition card, by band, and the source's reveal card
ArchiveEntry                  the calendar of past days, and a past day's own board
SoundSwitch                   the sound switch in Settings, and a mute that is remembered
LicencesList                  Settings to the licences, each one's text, and Soundscape's notices
